method: Each mutant replaces one fragment of a subject file that occurs exactly once (asserted), runs the command over the named test files, and restores the original bytes (sha256 re-checked at the end). A mutant is killed when the run exits non-zero; killedBy names the test files with a failing test, failedTests each failing test. The unmutated baseline passed first.
